1.
Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

3. The present appeal preferred by the insurer under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988,
assails the award dated 16.12.2022 passed by the learned Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, insofar as the quantum of compensation is concerned.

4. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that while considering the annual income of the deceased, the learned Tribunal had also included interest being received by the deceased on FDRs held by him without appreciating the fact that the said interest will now accrue in favour of the claimants.
5. Upon the appellant taking steps, issue notice to respondent nos.1 to 3 through all permissible modes.

6. Taking into account that no recovery rights have been granted in favour of the appellant under the impugned award, no notice is required to be issued to respondent nos.4 & 5.
7.

sentences.text: In the meanwhile, let the TCR be requisitioned and digitized before the next date.
9. This is an application for stay preferred by the appellant.

10.The application is disposed of by directing the appellant to deposit, within six weeks, 50% of the awarded amount alongwith up to date interest, with the learned Tribunal with a further direction to the learned Tribunal to release the same in favour of the respondents/claimants as per the scheme of disbursal contained in the impugned award.
11.
Subject to the appellant depositing the amount in terms of this order, the operation of the impugned award will remain stayed during the pendency of the present appeal.
